scope: Synthetic sidebar DOM and frame results, not the live hospital Portal
checks: Reads a narrow vertical login name immediately below logout
Line breaks and fullwidth whitespace in the sidebar are normalized
Hidden names and patient names in the query area are ignored
Conflicting visible names fail closed instead of picking one
Navigation labels are not treated as pharmacist names
Without the login-sidebar anchor, no name is inferred
A login page does not supply a pharmacist
Legacy bare text nodes separated by BR are read as one name
A sibling frame can supply the name; conflicting frames are rejected
